## Services

### Wi-Fi and Internet Access

Free Wi-Fi is available at all Merri Creek Library Service branches. Connect to the network **MCLS-Public** and follow the prompts to accept the terms of use. There is no time limit on daily sessions, though the network may be slower during peak periods such as school holidays.

Public internet computers are available at each branch:

- **Central Library** – 12 computers (including 2 accessible workstations with adjustable desks and screen-reader software)
- **Eastgate Branch** – 6 computers
- **Riverside Branch** – 8 computers
- **Northfields Mobile Library** – 2 laptops available for in-vehicle use (not for loan)

Computer sessions are limited to 60 minutes per day per library card. Visitors without a library card can request a guest pass at the service desk. Printing from public computers is available in black and white (20c per page) and colour ($1.00 per page). Wireless printing from personal devices is supported at Central and Riverside; please ask staff for the printer name and PIN.

### Printing, Scanning and Photocopying

All branches offer self-service photocopying and printing. Scanning to email or USB is free of charge at Central, Eastgate and Riverside. The Mobile Library does not carry a scanner but can accept print jobs sent ahead to the next stop – allow 24 hours notice.

Photocopying rates:

- Black and white: 20c per A4 page, 40c per A3 page
- Colour: $1.00 per A4 page, $1.50 per A3 page

Payment is by coins or a reusable copy card (available from the service desk, $2.00 plus value loaded). Cards can be used across all branches.

### Meeting Rooms and Study Spaces

**Central Library** has two bookable meeting rooms:

- **Birrarung Room** – seats up to 12, equipped with a 55-inch screen, HDMI and VGA connections, whiteboard and video-conferencing camera. Hire fee: $30 per hour (community/not-for-profit rate $15 per hour).
- **Wurundjeri Room** – seats up to 30, with a projector, PA system and kitchenette. Hire fee: $60 per hour (community/not-for-profit rate $30 per hour).

**Eastgate Branch** has one smaller meeting room (seats 8) available for $20 per hour, or $10 per hour for community groups. **Riverside Branch** does not have bookable rooms but has a quiet study area on the mezzanine level with power outlets at every desk.

Bookings can be made in person, by phone, or online through the MCLS website. Rooms must be booked at least 48 hours in advance. Cancellations with less than 24 hours notice may incur a fee.

### Home Delivery Service

The Home Delivery Service provides library materials to Merri Creek residents who are unable to visit a branch due to illness, disability, frailty or caring responsibilities. Deliveries are made fortnightly by library staff or trained volunteers.

To register, contact the Home Delivery Coordinator on 1300 555 774 or email homedelivery@mcls.vic.gov.au. A short phone assessment determines eligibility. Once registered, you will receive a phone call or email each fortnight to select items, or you can provide a standing list of preferences. There is no charge for this service.

The Mobile Library also stops at several aged-care facilities and retirement villages on its regular route. Please see the Mobile Library timetable for details.

### Children's and Youth Services

All branches run regular storytime sessions during school terms:

- **Baby Rhyme Time** (0–12 months) – Central: Tuesday 10:00 AM; Eastgate: Thursday 10:00 AM; Riverside: Friday 10:00 AM
- **Toddler Storytime** (1–3 years) – Central: Wednesday 10:00 AM; Eastgate: Monday 10:00 AM; Riverside: Wednesday 10:00 AM
- **Preschool Storytime** (3–5 years) – Central: Thursday 10:00 AM; Eastgate: Tuesday 10:00 AM; Riverside: Monday 10:00 AM

We'd love to hear from you! Whether you have a question about your membership, need help placing a hold, want to suggest a purchase, or have feedback about our services, there are several ways to get in touch.

### General Enquiries
For anything else, call 1300 555 770 or email info@mcls.vic.gov.au. Our phone lines are answered during branch opening hours, Monday to Saturday. Messages left outside these hours are returned on the next business day.

### Online Contact Form
Prefer to write it down? Use our online contact form. We aim to respond to all online enquiries within two business days. The form is the quickest way to reach us for:

- Membership queries
- Account and borrowing questions
- Suggestions for new titles or resources
- Feedback or complaints
- Requests for room hire or Home Delivery Service

To send us feedback about a specific branch or service, please mention the branch name in the subject line so we can make sure it reaches the right team.

### Feedback and Complaints
We welcome feedback — positive and negative — as it helps us improve. If you have a complaint, you can raise it in person at any branch, by phone, by email, or through the online form. We aim to acknowledge complaints within three business days and resolve them within ten business days. Our complaints process is outlined in the Customer Service Charter, available at all branches and on our website.

### Friends of the Merri Creek Library
The Friends of the Merri Creek Library is a volunteer group that supports the library through fundraising, advocacy and community events. They run the popular book sale table at Central Branch (first Saturday of each month) and have helped fund the children's area renovations and the new audiobook collection. New members are always welcome — no experience needed, just enthusiasm. To find out more, drop into any branch and ask at the desk, or email friends@mcls.vic.gov.au.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I get a library card?
Library membership is free for anyone who lives, works, studies, or owns property in the Merri Creek municipality. You can join online or at any branch. Bring one form of photo ID and proof of address, or if joining online, provide your details and we'll post your card to you. Children under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the membership form. Cards are issued immediately at branches.

### How many items can I borrow?
Most members can borrow up to 30 items at a time. This includes books, magazines, DVDs, CDs, audiobooks, and items from our Library of Things. The loan period is three weeks for books and magazines, one week for DVDs and audiobooks, and varies for special collections like the Library of Things (check the item label). You can renew items twice, as long as no one else has placed a hold on them. Renewals can be done online, by phone, or in person.

documents.content:
The Central Library is our flagship branch and houses the largest collection, including the local history archive, the children's discovery space, and the community meeting rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the building. Public computers are located on the mezzanine level (bookings recommended during peak times).

### Eastgate Branch
**Address:** Shop 12, Eastgate Shopping Centre, 88 Eastgate Boulevard, Merri Creek East VIC 3551  
**Phone:** (03) 5550 8450  
**Email:** eastgate@mcls.shire.gov.au  
**Access:** Lift access from the shopping centre car park; automatic doors at the shop front.

Eastgate is a smaller neighbourhood branch focused on popular fiction, children's picture books, and quick-browse collections. A self-service kiosk is available for after-hours returns and pickups.

### Riverside Branch
**Address:** 12 Riverside Parade, Merri Creek West VIC 3552  
**Phone:** (03) 5550 8490  
**Email:** riverside@mcls.shire.gov.au  
**Access:** Level entry from the parade; on-street parking nearby.

Riverside Branch specialises in large-print and audio collections, with a dedicated quiet reading room. The branch hosts regular seniors' programs and book clubs.

### Northfields Mobile Library
**Mobile stops across Northfields, Wattle Grove, and the surrounding rural areas.**  
**Phone:** (03) 5550 8420  
**Email:** mobile@mcls.shire.gov.au

The Mobile Library visits approximately 25 stops on a fortnightly rotation. Each stop is typically 30–45 minutes. documents.content:
## Services

### Wi-Fi and Internet Access

Free Wi-Fi is available at all Merri Creek Library Service branches. Connect to the network **MCLS-Public** and follow the prompts to accept the terms of use. There is no time limit on daily sessions, though the network may be slower during peak periods such as school holidays.

Public internet computers are available at each branch:

- **Central Library** – 12 computers (including 2 accessible workstations with adjustable desks and screen-reader software)
- **Eastgate Branch** – 6 computers
- **Riverside Branch** – 8 computers
- **Northfields Mobile Library** – 2 laptops available for in-vehicle use (not for loan)

Computer sessions are limited to 60 minutes per day per library card. Visitors without a library card can request a guest pass at the service desk. Printing from public computers is available in black and white (20c per page) and colour ($1.00 per page). Wireless printing from personal devices is supported at Central and Riverside; please ask staff for the printer name and PIN.

### Printing, Scanning and Photocopying

All branches offer self-service photocopying and printing. Scanning to email or USB is free of charge at Central, Eastgate and Riverside. The Mobile Library does not carry a scanner but can accept print jobs sent ahead to the next stop – allow 24 hours notice.

Photocopying rates:

- Black and white: 20c per A4 page, 40c per A3 page
- Colour: $1.00 per A4 page, $1.50 per A3 page

Payment is by coins or a reusable copy card (available from the service desk, $2.00 plus value loaded). Cards can be used across all branches.

### Meeting Rooms and Study Spaces

**Central Library** has two bookable meeting rooms:

- **Birrarung Room** – seats up to 12, equipped with a 55-inch screen, HDMI and VGA connections, whiteboard and video-conferencing camera. Hire fee: $30 per hour (community/not-for-profit rate $15 per hour).
- **Wurundjeri Room** – seats up to 30, with a projector, PA system and kitchenette. Hire fee: $60 per hour (community/not-for-profit rate $30 per hour).

**Eastgate Branch** has one smaller meeting room (seats 8) available for $20 per hour, or $10 per hour for community groups. **Riverside Branch** does not have bookable rooms but has a quiet study area on the mezzanine level with power outlets at every desk.

Bookings can be made in person, by phone, or online through the MCLS website. Rooms must be booked at least 48 hours in advance. Cancellations with less than 24 hours notice may incur a fee.

### Home Delivery Service

The Home Delivery Service provides library materials to Merri Creek residents who are unable to visit a branch due to illness, disability, frailty or caring responsibilities. Deliveries are made fortnightly by library staff or trained volunteers.

To register, contact the Home Delivery Coordinator on 1300 555 774 or email homedelivery@mcls.vic.gov.au. A short phone assessment determines eligibility. Once registered, you will receive a phone call or email each fortnight to select items, or you can provide a standing list of preferences. There is no charge for this service.

The Mobile Library also stops at several aged-care facilities and retirement villages on its regular route. Please see the Mobile Library timetable for details.

### Children's and Youth Services

All branches run regular storytime sessions during school terms:

- **Baby Rhyme Time** (0–12 months) – Central: Tuesday 10:00 AM; Eastgate: Thursday 10:00 AM; Riverside: Friday 10:00 AM
- **Toddler Storytime** (1–3 years) – Central: Wednesday 10:00 AM; Eastgate: Monday 10:00 AM; Riverside: Wednesday 10:00 AM
- **Preschool Storytime** (3–5 years) – Central: Thursday 10:00 AM; Eastgate: Tuesday 10:00 AM; Riverside: Monday 10:00 AM

## Contact Us

We'd love to hear from you! Whether you have a question about your membership, need help placing a hold, want to suggest a purchase, or have feedback about our services, there are several ways to get in touch.

### Central Branch
- **Address:** 42 Merri Creek Road, Northcote VIC 3070
- **Phone:** 1300 555 770 (during opening hours)
- **Email:** central@mcls.vic.gov.au

### Eastgate Branch
- **Address:** Shop 14, Eastgate Shopping Centre, 120 Bell Street, Preston VIC 3072
- **Phone:** 1300 555 771
- **Email:** eastgate@mcls.vic.gov.au

### Riverside Branch
- **Address:** 8 Riverside Drive, Fairfield VIC 3078
- **Phone:** 1300 555 772
- **Email:** riverside@mcls.vic.gov.au

### Mobile Library
- **Phone:** 1300 555 773
- **Email:** mobile@mcls.vic.gov.au

### General Enquiries
For anything else, call 1300 555 770 or email info@mcls.vic.gov.au. Our phone lines are answered during branch opening hours, Monday to Saturday. Messages left outside these hours are returned on the next business day.

### Online Contact Form
Prefer to write it down? Use our online contact form. We aim to respond to all online enquiries within two business days. The form is the quickest way to reach us for:

- Membership queries
- Account and borrowing questions
- Suggestions for new titles or resources
- Feedback or complaints
- Requests for room hire or Home Delivery Service

To send us feedback about a specific branch or service, please mention the branch name in the subject line so we can make sure it reaches the right team.

### Feedback and Complaints
We welcome feedback — positive and negative — as it helps us improve. If you have a complaint, you can raise it in person at any branch, by phone, by email, or through the online form. We aim to acknowledge complaints within three business days and resolve them within ten business days. Our complaints process is outlined in the Customer Service Charter, available at all branches and on our website.

### Friends of the Merri Creek Library
The Friends of the Merri Creek Library is a volunteer group that supports the library through fundraising, advocacy and community events. They run the popular book sale table at Central Branch (first Saturday of each month) and have helped fund the children's area renovations and the new audiobook collection. New members are always welcome — no experience needed, just enthusiasm. To find out more, drop into any branch and ask at the desk, or email friends@mcls.vic.gov.au.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I get a library card?
Library membership is free for anyone who lives, works, studies, or owns property in the Merri Creek municipality. You can join online or at any branch. Bring one form of photo ID and proof of address, or if joining online, provide your details and we'll post your card to you. Children under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the membership form. Cards are issued immediately at branches.

### How many items can I borrow?
Most members can borrow up to 30 items at a time. This includes books, magazines, DVDs, CDs, audiobooks, and items from our Library of Things. The loan period is three weeks for books and magazines, one week for DVDs and audiobooks, and varies for special collections like the Library of Things (check the item label). You can renew items twice, as long as no one else has placed a hold on them. Renewals can be done online, by phone, or in person.
